title: New Features: Growth Chart & Prescription Discounts
body_markdown:
Our team is constantly developing improvements and updates to make your membership easier, faster, and a better value for your family. This week we’re launching another milestone in that journey with two new exciting features.


## Growth Tracker:


The height & weight of your child is valuable information for doctors have, and seeing your child’s development over time bring additional insight and understanding to their overall health. We’ve made tracking this information easy and seamless with our new Growth Tracking feature.


\[Insert Screenshot\]


You’ll be able to easily add height and weight updates and see your child’s progress as they grow into young adults, and get valuable insight into their health and development.


For information on how to use the growth chart and answers to common questions, see our series of articles:


- [How to Interpret Your Child’s Growth Chart](https://blueberrypediatrics.com/how-to-interpret-your-childs-growth-chart/)
- [Growth Curve Suggestive of Low Weight](https://blueberrypediatrics.com/growth-curve-suggestive-of-low-weight/)
- [Growth Curve Suggestive of High Weight or Obesity](https://blueberrypediatrics.com/growth-curve-suggestive-of-high-weight-or-obesity/)
- [Alternative Growth Charts](https://blueberrypediatrics.com/alternative-growth-charts/)


## Prescription Discounts with Your GoodRx Card:


We’re also excited to announce a partnership with GoodRx.com. Through this partnership, every Blueberry member has access to discounts on prescriptions through GoodRx using a GoodRx card included in their account.

## How to Use the New Features:


These new additions to your membership are currently only available through your Blueberry[website account portal](https://app.blueberrypediatrics.com/) , but we will be adding them to our mobile app in the very near future.


More features are always on the way, and if there’s anything you’d like to see that would make your membership experience better, always feel free tolet us know . Have a wonderful holiday season!
